in_sanskrit.name: रागिनी
in_sanskrit.meaning: One who possesses melody or emotion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The feminine form of 'Rag' which means melody, tune, or emotion.

in_hindi.name: रागिनी
in_hindi.long_meaning: A woman who specializes in or possesses Raga (melody, tune, or emotion).

in_tamil.name: ராகினி
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who bestows the melody or tune (Raga) on others.

in_telugu.name: రాగినీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: A woman who embodies or possesses the essence of Raga (melody, tune, or emotion).

in_marathi.name: Ragini
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Queen of the Night
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ragini हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who is the queen of the night, a manifestation of Parvati, Goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. Ragini is also a name for the moon and represents the cool, calming, and nurturing energies of the night.

in_bengali.name: Ragini
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Queen of the Night
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ragini একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She who is the queen of the night, a manifestation of Parvati, Goddess of love, beauty, and fertility. Ragini is also a name for the moon and represents the cool, calming, and nurturing energies of the night.
